summary: Iteration 30 - Multi-language Support Testing Complete. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified language selector with 12 languages, translations for French, German, Spanish, Arabic (RTL), and all booking flow steps (search, room selection, guest details). Facilities, policies, trust footer, and footer sections all translate correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created test translation overrides for aldgate-flats/fr during API testing.

Arabic (ar) triggers RTL layout (dir='rtl'). Backend translation override APIs at /api/translations/{property_id}/{lang_code} work correctly.
